contentHtml:
Indian multinational pharmaceutical company NATCO Pharma announced on Monday the launch of Carboplatin Injection, a generic version of Paraplatin in the US market, by its US subsidiary, NATCO Pharma USA.

The American subsidiary would launch the product in manufacturing collaboration with Teyro Labs Pvt Ltd, an Indian pharmaceutical company based out of Chennai.

Read more: Natco Pharma to invest Rs 2,500 crore in South Africa expansion

According to the statement released by the company, the launch is aimed at addressing the critical shortage of the drug in the US market.

Carboplatin injection is used for the treatment of advanced ovarian carcinoma, including first-line combination therapy and palliative treatment of recurrent disease after prior chemotherapy, the release said.

The injection recorded sales estimated at $27.8 million in the US for 12 months ending June 2026, the report said, citing industry sales data.
